subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: Should the iPhone tab bar be permanently replaced by this single sidebar-shell navigation model once the listed session-state repairs are complete?
rationale: The branch removes established phone root navigation and adds a broad dashboard/sidebar interaction model; the protected maintainer label means the permanent navigation direction requires explicit human confirmation.

options.title: Sponsor the sidebar shell
options.body: Approve the single-shell direction, require the four state/action repairs and focused regression coverage, then merge after refreshed review.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Retain part of the existing phone navigation and land only the independently safe sidebar/session improvements in a smaller follow-up.

options.title: Pause the redesign
options.body: Defer the navigation replacement until a maintainer records a durable iOS navigation direction and acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the sidebar shell
recommendation.body: Approve the single-shell direction, require the four state/action repairs and focused regression coverage, then merge after refreshed review.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR body describes this as a maintainer-directed redesign, and steipete authored both this implementation and the linked Overview-retirement direction.
